definitions.explanation: At a right angle to a horizontal surface or to another line.

examples.japanese: {垂直|すいちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{垂直|すいちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交|まじ}わる→交わる：18379_majiwaru⟧。
examples.english: These two lines intersect at right angles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{垂直|すいちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The wall stands perpendicular to the ground.

notes:
{垂直|すいちょく} means vertical (straight up and down) or perpendicular (at a 90-degree angle to something). Can function as a noun or na-adjective.

FORMS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}な/⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: vertical ~
- {垂直|すいちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: vertically

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand vertically
- {垂直|すいちょく}⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧: vertical direction
- {垂直|すいちょく}⟦{離着陸|りちゃくりく}→離着陸：20749_richakuriku⟧: vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL)
- {垂直|すいちょく}⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧: vertical drop/free fall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}: vertical/perpendicular
- ⟦{水平|すいへい}→水平：04304_suihei⟧: horizontal/level
- ⟦{平行|へいこう}→平行：05445_heikou⟧: parallel
- ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧: diagonal, slanted
